snippet.title: The Fame Game: Welcome to Hollywood - Official Trailer | PC
snippet.description:
The player becomes Jonathan, a former “ordinary man” who has just been cast as the main character in the country’s hottest television show. As he climbs the Hollywood ladder to stardom, he meets seven beauties vying to be his leading lady. Who will you choose? The adventure is up to you…  
The spotlight’s on, the stage is set—your Hollywood story is about to begin.
Head over to the Steam store now, search for The Fame Game, and add it to your wishlist to be the first to step into this glamorous dream—and never miss a chance to be the star.
